$comment: D4.47 — every path that changes clause text after the engine has rendered it, what guards it, and the test that fails if the guard is removed.
A path missing from this list is a path nobody has checked. tests/mutationPaths.test.mjs reads this file and verifies each entry against the code.

paths.guard: refusalReasons with introducedFiguresForbidden and partyNames (figures, locks, meaning markers)
guardDraftMutation with introducedFiguresForbidden (figures, locks, meaning markers)
guardDraftMutation with introducedFiguresForbidden; figures the user typed are authorised
paths.was: Applied in the browser with no check at all.
Unguarded. Measured a fixed point on every engine draft; it normalises edited text.

paths.guard: Engine drafting from the final clause set; touches only the clauses in survival_semantics.referenced_by.

not_machine_mutations: Manual edits in the editor, restoring a saved version, and revision regeneration reusing wording the user accepted: the user's own text.

Generation stages before the first validation (hardening, quality controls, normalisation, category mapping): the engine drafting; covered by the conservation gate. Exception found in D4.47: normalisation is not idempotent (NORMALISATION_NOT_IDEMPOTENT), so it must not be run twice over a finished draft; the survival stage normalises only the clauses it re-renders. Fixed in D4.49: the normaliser is idempotent (tests/normalisationIdempotence.test.mjs); the survival stage keeps its narrower scope because the quality controls are not proven idempotent.

meaning_markers.$what: For AI changes (tailoring, /fix-issue, chat) the guard reads these from the words, before and after.
caught: obligation words changed (shall/must/may/will, and their negatives)
conditions, qualifications and exceptions added or removed (unless, except, excluding, provided that, subject to, notwithstanding, only if, save that, if, where)
remedies added or removed (indemnify, damages, terminate, injunction, specific performance, interest, penalty, liquidated, refund, forfeit, set-off, suspend)
a party added, removed or exchanged for another
numbers written as words (two to a hundred)
not_caught: temporal order: 'before' to 'after', 'within' to 'not later than'
standards of conduct: 'reasonable' to 'sole discretion', 'best endeavours' to 'reasonable endeavours'
the subject matter a clause applies to: 'Confidential Information' to 'trade secrets'
a party described rather than named (the guard reads defined names only)
meaning_markers.$why_not_caught_is_recorded: These pass the guard. tests/mutationPaths.test.mjs asserts that they do, so that the list cannot quietly become false in either direction.

export_fidelity.docx: Every figure in the draft text is present in the DOCX document text, on the whole corpus (tests/mutationPaths.test.mjs).
export_fidelity.pdf: NOT verified: no PDF text extractor is installed; the PDF is built from the same text as the DOCX.
